title: ConstructAdversaryReport
description: ADR 0008 Axis 1 — the funded construct-adversary's enumerated search. The adversary is authored to BREAK the construction (referent = the frozen question, NOT the proposer's reasoning) and has no accept authority. construct_valid is earned ONLY by a funded failure: budget spent, a real search over distinct pass_but_wrong worlds, and no breaking instance. The harness RE-DERIVES the verdict from worlds_tested (research_harness/construct_adversary.py) — a self-reported 'survived' that enumerates a breaking world is overruled.

question_id.description: Must match the pinned frozen_question.question_id — the adversary must attack the frozen question, not a restated one.

construction_ref.description: Which construction (node id / claim) is under attack.

budget_total.description: Search budget the adversary was funded for (iterations / candidate worlds). budget-0 → auto-invalid: a certification that did not search proves nothing.

pass_but_wrong_region.description: The declared region the adversary searched: classes of worlds where the construction's measurement could pass yet the frozen answer is NO. Empty/absent → invalid (every non-trivial measurement has such worlds; claiming none is a lie).

worlds_tested.description: The enumerated search. Each world states whether the construction's MEASUREMENT passes there and what the FROZEN question's true answer is — a world with measurement_passes=true AND frozen_answer='no' is a break.

breaking_instance.description: Set when the adversary explicitly found a pass-but-wrong world. Non-null → broken (construct-invalid).

produced_by.description: Provenance stamp. The adversary persona — not the proposer — authors this report.
